name: Yogesh Tekwani
summary:
Senior Business Development Leader with 13+ years driving revenue growth and market expansion in the
luxury industry. Expertise in territory development, multi-state operations, B2B2C sales, channel
management, and strategic partnerships across real estate, architecture, hospitality, and developer
segments. Currently leading regional growth for Kohler India with accountability for business development,
key account management, distribution network expansion, and sales pipeline governance. Manage 300+
architect and designer relationships and 100+ dealer partnerships while consistently exceeding revenue
targets through data-driven go-to-market strategies. Proven track record in C-suite engagement, team
leadership, premium brand positioning, and market penetration. Nationally recognized for execution
excellence and measurable business impact.
EDUCATION: 1. PGDM — California State University and Ahmedabad Management Association (2020 - 2021) [conf 0.95, review=False]
2. BBA — BBA Veer Narmad South Gujarat University (2008 - 2011) [conf 0.95, review=False]
company_details: Total experience: 14.5 years (174 months, 2 overlaps merged)
1. Mumbai, India @ Kohler India (May 2022 - Present) [conf 0.98, review=False]

responsibilities: Territory Coverage: Mumbai, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Nagpur, Nashik, Aurangabad
Drove 200% revenue growth, surpassing Rs 100 Cr+ in annual sales, strengthening Kohler’s presence across Western & Central India.
Expanded Kohler's footprint across seven high-growth regions, successfully acquiring and developing high-potential territories, driving brand exclusivity in ultra-luxury and large-scale projects.
Secured long-term business contracts worth INR 45 Cr, creating sustainable revenue streams and repeat business across high-value clientele.

Built and nurtured a strategic network of 300+ architects, specifiers, and interior designers, ensuring Kohler’s specification in premium residential, commercial & hospitality developments & private luxury residences.
Managed a 100+ dealer network, strengthening channel sales, accelerating market penetration, and increasing regional brand visibility.
Achieved an industry-leading Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 88, the highest in the country, demonstrating Kohler’s excellence in customer experience, engagement, and satisfaction.
Optimized revenue streams by 20%, leveraging value engineering and strategic pricing models to enhance profit margins while maintaining product exclusivity.
Implemented data-driven business strategies, increasing sales pipeline efficiency by 25%, optimizing customer acquisition, and enhancing forecasting accuracy for sustained profitability.
Conducted competitor benchmarking and trend analysis, enabling strategic pricing and positioning Kohler as a market leader in architect-specified projects.
Delivered critical market intelligence to product development teams, identifying luxury segment gaps that resulted in launch of 3 new high-demand SKUs generating ₹12+ Cr in first-year revenue
Built and led high-performance business development team of 7 professionals, improving productivity by 50% through structured training programs, performance metrics, and incentive optimization
Conceptualized and executed 10+ experiential brand engagement events (architect summits, designer showcases, project tours) driving brand affinity and expanding high-value customer engagement.
Key Projects: Surat Diamond Bourse (World's Largest Office Building), Surat Airport, Radisson Surat, Hyatt Place
Established and scaled the Projects & Hospitality vertical from scratch, driving 150% revenue growth in
vs. 2020, positioning Hafele as a preferred partner in the luxury residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

Managed a diverse product portfolio including Architectural Hardware, Furniture Fittings, Digital Locks, Appliances, Automatic Doors, Movable Walls, Surfaces, and Sanitary Fittings, ensuring optimal product mix for varied project requirements.
Secured 55% of total revenue from repeat business through strategic long-term agreements with premier developers and hospitality groups demonstrating exceptional account retention

Collaborated cross-functionally with specification, estimation, design, operations, and finance teams ensuring competitive pricing, value engineering, optimal margins, and cash flow management (DSO optimization).
Developed comprehensive sales presentations and data-driven business analytics using advanced Excel modeling and PowerPoint enabling strategic decision-making and C-level stakeholder engagement.

Achievements: Revenue Leadership: Managed Rs 100+ Crore annual revenue across Western and Central India,
consistently exceeding sales targets through strategic market development and premium brand positioning
in the luxury building materials sector.
Relationship Management: Built and maintained 300+ architect and specifier partnerships and secured
50+ premier developer and hospitality accounts, driving specification-led sales and long-term brand loyalty.
Channel Expansion: Scaled distribution network to 100+ channel partners across multi-state markets,
establishing structured B2B2C ecosystems that increased market penetration and revenue growth.
Team Leadership: Led and mentored 7+ business development professionals, fostering high-performance
culture and driving consistent achievement of regional sales objectives.
Industry Recognition: 13+ years of proven expertise in luxury sales, business development, and strategic
account management with national recognition for execution excellence.
